rules.text: ـيّ (nisba/relational) and ـيّة (abstract noun) are DISTINCT classifiers; both share a geminated yaa, so the shadda itself must be written evidence, never assumed
a candidate_pending function label is a SUFFIX CLASSIFICATION only -- it never infers the base lexeme's identity or a contextual sense
an unmarked (unvocalised) surface carries no shadda evidence and abstains insufficient_features -- normalisation is never treated as confirmation
